name: emoji
note: Emoji and symbol sequences that both the engine and Chrome resolve identically in the current system state (a color emoji face, Noto Color Emoji, installed at user level). Installing an emoji-capable face changes Chrome's per-glyph fallback for emoji-presentation codepoints — I ZWJ family, flag, keycap, skin-tone and VS16 sequences now resolve through the color face at a 1.25em cell that the engine cannot reproduce, so those strings no longer measure at parity and were dropped from this fixture. The reclassified smiley string and the remaining symbol coverage measure on DejaVu Sans outline glyphs (exact parity), plus one glyph on the registered emoji face to pin the documented ~0.03px CBDT-cell delta (Chrome's Skia rounds the color strike's advance to the 1.25em cell; the engine returns the hmtx 2550/2048 advance).
